content.summary: The correction discloses a genuine external H27 provenance limitation without establishing that H27 is false. The ordinary composition still depends essentially on that imported theorem; local replay cannot authenticate its historical computation. The revised manuscript represents this boundary accurately. Inspected inventories reconcile, and the fresh Q8 leaf agrees with its archived exact arithmetic. No new required revision at this scope.

findings.statement: The external H27 source-to-historical-run provenance remains unverified here, and the inspected script does not substantiate the README's claimed three compressed-archive hash comparisons.
findings.disposition: The superseding note and manuscript now expose the limitation. H27 remains an essential cited theorem import; neither repeated local PASS results nor reviewer agreement repairs or independently establishes it.

findings.statement: The inspected completed inventories support the stated 43, 169 and 329 branch-incidence counts, while preserving the unique degree19 equality case.
findings.disposition: Keep arithmetic verification, strict exclusion, ordinary equality closure and complete case coverage as separate obligations. Counts and hash bindings alone do not prove the mathematical row premises.

findings.statement: The one fresh Q8 reproduction is a source-pinned, shared-builder exact replay, not a new independent model or whole-proof reconstruction.
findings.disposition: The revised external assurance limit is additional to the existing local shared-builder and partial-Lean limitations.

revisions.action: Checked the round-four-to-five diff and retained definitions.
revisions.result: Only the H27 source-scope paragraph and superseding-note pointer changed. The resolved neighbourhood notation and maximum-degree root selection remain intact.

revisions.action: Reassessed the earlier assurance qualification against the fetched H27 source records and superseding note.
revisions.result: The earlier broad archive-authentication wording must no longer be relied upon. The current manuscript accurately discloses the source-to-run inspection gap while retaining H27 as an external premise.

checks.scope: H27 source correction against actual archived retrievals
checks.method: Read the retrieved README and complete shell script, decoded the saved untruncated Git tree, and recomputed both text blobs' SHA256 and Git-blob SHA1 commitments.
checks.observation: Both text identities match. Tree d4d5723267c662291efdadfa6e7061d919e76fa9 has 117 entries, truncated=false, and no provenance path. The shell visibly extracts three archives, verifies run records through another program, compares two frontier hashes and runs small controls; it does not explicitly compare the three compressed archive hashes. No external executable, compressed archive or historical run was inspected or executed by this reviewer.

checks.scope: Essential H27 value and noncircular proof composition
checks.method: Re-derived the direct A3 deficit calculation with a symbolic intersecting cap h and compared its uses with the global dependency roadmap.
checks.observation: At order 68, mu>=68-h. Given the stated A3 map, sum e=8h-204 and a[i]>=3h-68-(8h-204)=136-5h. Thus h=27 gives mu>=41 and a[i]>=1, whereas h=28 gives only mu>=40 and a[i]>=-4. The roadmap imports H27 before the degree exclusions and uses it again for terminal pools; none of those dependent checks is offered as a proof of H27. The numerical argument cannot be transferred unchanged to cap28.

checks.method: Parsed the actual complete indices and coverage records; independently reconciled branch counts and recomputed receipt/replay hashes for the 123-entry D18 P10 index and 94-entry D17 Q8 index.
checks.observation: D19 has 43 entries: 29 strict-bound conclusions, 13 exact infeasibility conclusions and one explicitly nonexcluding equality conclusion, Ypattern01-Z. D18 counts are 12+34+123=169; D17 counts are 12+131+92+94=329. All 217 selected receipt/replay pairs match their saved commitments. These are branch incidences and file-integrity checks, not 217 independent reconstructions.

checks.scope: Fresh Q8 E4_56 replay and precise assurance
checks.method: Read the non-overwriting wrapper, reproduction guide, manifest and fresh receipt; matched the frozen evaluator and input commitments and compared the exact_replay object with the active archived replay.
checks.observation: The wrapper pins evaluator SHA256 10304e6fa2f3adfea9de387e82601ee6eef7f445b9460e35827d2e2eced634c8 and invokes replay(), not the solver. Fresh and archived arithmetic objects agree: H=-398506390, correction=-7748631, hence upper numerator=-406255021<0 at scale 10000000000 across 24727 columns. The source explicitly reconstructs through the same hashed producer build(). I inspected the prior fresh execution's evidence but did not rerun it in this round.
